'''Chakdin''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Callow Batta]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] former [[Professor/Legends|professor]] of governmental and [[Politics/Legends|political]] history at the [[University of Sanbra]] who turned to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] after he had been fired by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] authorities<ref name="AIR" /> at some point around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Date Batta">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Furthermore, ''Alliance Intelligence Reports'' states that [[Callow Batta]] was fired "about a year ago" and therefore around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> was proficient in Chakdin.<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chakdin was mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" />
